$comment: Structural speed budgets checked by perf-smoke (bun scripts/perf/smoke.ts) on the 100-document fixture. Counts, not timings: they do not depend on the runner's speed. Rewrite with bun scripts/perf/smoke.ts --update; a budget that rises needs a "why" on its entry, which bun run perf:guards checks.

requests.why: Requests per click (API, HTML frame and page loads; cached assets aside). Each extra request is a round trip on a phone, 150 ms or more.

chain.why: Requests a click's content waited for one after another once clicked (in-tab clicks and reopening the app; a hover's early requests aside). Plan 15 target: at most one on a click's critical path.

revisit content.why: Opening a document again reads its content from the browser cache (documents by revision, #113 and #117).

idle requests.why: Requests from an untouched tab at Home in 75 s. Plan 15 target: about one a minute; Home checks Pending, Recent and Activity every 60 s while it has no socket (registered in perf:guards).

redirects.why: A redirect adds a round trip before anything loads (Plan 16 gate D5).

cold js.why: JavaScript files a cold page load fetches before content. Each file is a request the phone waits on before any data.

dom.why: Elements once a screen settles. Long lists render only what is visible (W3-05); layout cost grows with the element count.

popin.why: On revisits, frames in which content becomes visible (0.1% of the screen or more) after the screen's content showed, until it settles. A revisit renders from what the tab holds and should show its final screen at once.

indicators.why: On revisits, loading episodes (skeletons, spinners, busy regions; parts that appear together count once) from the click until the screen settles. A revisit should show none.

io stat.why: File stats per hot request, solo owner. Plan 16 gate D4 and the Plan 17 per-request I/O work.

io read.why: File opens, reads and directory reads per hot request, solo owner. Hot reads come from derived data, not files (docs/performance.md).

io sql.why: SQL statements per hot request, solo owner, Better Auth's included.

cold js, open the app at Home.why: The sidebar's Getting Started row and its progress ring share a small chunk with the member welcome, so every page loads one more file. Configured avatars share one additional 1.1 KB gzip graphics module; identity metadata reuses the existing workspace response. Removing the earlier single-link share dialog took its inputs, dialog shell and clipboard helper out of the always-loaded share button chunk. The sidebar and other eager screens still use them, so the bundler now emits them as five small shared chunks preloaded in parallel: the same code, 4 KB more in total.

dom, cold, open the app at Home.why: Each Space icon and person avatar sits on its recognition color, one more element per Space row and avatar.

cold js, open Space.why: Configured agent logos, custom icons and person avatars share one 1.1 KB gzip graphics module loaded by the sidebar; identity metadata reuses the existing workspace response. Removing the earlier single-link share dialog took its inputs, dialog shell and clipboard helper out of the always-loaded share button chunk. The sidebar and other eager screens still use them, so the bundler now emits them as five small shared chunks preloaded in parallel: the same code, 4 KB more in total. Space Home is rebuilt around the latest work (#485) and its page is now its own chunk, so documents, Threads and Settings no longer load it. A cold open of a Space fetches that chunk, the chunk of sections it shares with Home, and a 0.4 KB path helper that a pinned page's preview shares with the HTML Doc code: three more small files, preloaded in parallel. CI run 43560591047 on e6f0510 measured 25 against 22 on main bb09d44 (run 43557287192); the route is 4.7 KB gzip heavier in total, and every document route is lighter.

requests, cold, open Markdown doc.why: Main already measures 15 here (run 43557287192 on bb09d44): a late request from the load lands in this window, and the check let it pass while the cold pass stayed within its total. Space Home now asks for its Latest on a cold open (13 to 14 requests, within that click's own budget), which uses up the slack. The requests this load makes are the same as on main.

cold js, open Markdown doc.why: Configured agent logos, custom icons and person avatars share one 1.1 KB gzip graphics module loaded by the sidebar; identity metadata reuses the existing workspace response. Removing the earlier single-link share dialog took its inputs, dialog shell and clipboard helper out of the always-loaded share button chunk. The sidebar and other eager screens still use them, so the bundler now emits them as five small shared chunks preloaded in parallel: the same code, 4 KB more in total. A Doc's opening (its page check, the read-only first frame and the catalog re-check) is shared with the Library's skill page, so the bundler emits it as one 1 KB file preloaded with the Doc route: the same code, one file more. CI run 43638319195 measured 32 for a Doc with images; a Markdown doc measured within 31 on the same build, the window's late files deciding which.

requests, cold, open rich doc.why: Once the first screen settles, the app asks for every Space's sidebar contents in one request (GET /api/sidebar), so opening any Space shows its tree in the frame of the press; a cold load whose window is still open counts it, and a Space the page opens may refresh its own contents behind it. Measured on the PR's perf-smoke run.

cold js, open Threads.why: Comments show their messages with the Threads Markdown renderer, so the bundler moves that renderer out of the Threads chunk into one both share: one more small chunk on a cold open of Threads, preloaded with the rest, and none on revisits. Before that, removing the single-link share dialog split its inputs, dialog shell and clipboard helper into five small shared chunks. A pinned page's preview on Home (#485) uses the HTML Doc path helper, so the bundler moves that 0.4 KB helper out of the chunk the HTML Doc code kept it in: one more small file before Threads shows on a cold open, preloaded with the rest, and none on revisits. CI run 43560591047 on e6f0510 measured 34 against 33 on main bb09d44; the scripts this load fetches in all are unchanged at 61.

requests, revisit, open HTML doc.why: The perf browser now trusts the proxy's certificate, so its HTTP cache works as a browser's does. The HTML doc's frame comes from it: the page check and annotations.

chain, revisit, open HTML doc.why: The perf browser now trusts the proxy's certificate, so its HTTP cache works as a browser's does. Nothing waits on a download.

requests, revisit, open a file page.why: New journey (Plan 21): the page check. The image comes from the browser's cache at its versioned address.

chain, revisit, open a file page.why: New journey (Plan 21): the image comes from the browser's cache, so nothing waits on the page check.

requests, revisit, open a Doc with image.why: New journey (Plan 21): the page check and annotations. The images come from the browser's cache at their versioned addresses.

requests, revisit, open an HTML Doc with.why: New journey: the page check and annotations. The frame, images included, comes from the browser's cache at its revision.

chain, revisit, open a Doc with images.why: New journey (Plan 21): the images come from the browser's cache, so nothing waits on the page check.

chain, revisit, open an HTML Doc with im.why: New journey: the frame comes from the browser's cache, so nothing waits on a download.

requests, reopen, open the app at Home.why: The quick-click journey leaves a third Space open in the sidebar, so the reopened app also loads its contents. The sidebar reopens the Spaces a person left open, and each loads its tree (Space, docs, documents, records). The journey leaves two Spaces open. Once the first screen settles, the app asks for every Space's sidebar contents in one request (GET /api/sidebar), so opening any Space shows its tree in the frame of the press; a cold load whose window is still open counts it, and a Space the page opens may refresh its own contents behind it. Measured on the PR's perf-smoke run.
